text_to_image_prompt:
Output one image, aspect ratio 3:2 (approximately 1.500:1), target canvas 1536 × 1024 pixels.

Landscape 3:2 three-panel photographic head identity turnaround, equal-width panels separated by fine vertical white lines. One fictional adult Photographer, age 40, with light slightly weathered skin, brown eyes, short brown hair with a gently receding hairline, five-o’clock stubble, broad mature forehead, straight prominent nose and narrow natural lips. Left panel exact 90-degree profile looking left; center panel perfectly front-facing at eye level, upright head, level eyes and balanced shoulders; right panel opposite 90-degree profile looking right. One consistent skull, nose, chin, eyes, hairline and head scale through all rotations. Entire hair crown to upper chest visible in each panel. Neutral closed mouth, relaxed brows, no smile or flirtatious expression, no glasses or hat. Visible collar: gray shirt with fine vertical stripes. 85mm lens perspective, sharp face and gentle background separation. Plain matte cool-gray studio wall and gray floor, soft cool blue-gray daylight and even fill, subtle fine film grain, real pores, fine facial hair, matte skin and real fabric weave. Photographic live-action casting reference, no stylized 3D, no wax skin, heavy retouching, strong warm tint, drama lighting, text, labels or watermark.
reproduction_note: 文字可复用构图、气质与质感，但随机采样可能改变脸部细节；未验证仅凭文字可达到近乎一致。需要严格锁脸时请同时使用此图作为身份参考。

original_prompt: Make a LANDSCAPE 3:2 high-resolution three-panel realistic photographic head identity reference of the SAME fictional adult Photographer, age40. Preserve the same middle-aged man shown in the reference sheet's TOP head portraits: short brown hair with lightly receding hairline, light stubble, normal mature face. Use top row identity, ignore other panel layout. Exactly3 panels, left = true90-degree LEFT-facing profile (nose to outer left); center = perfectly straight FRONT eye-level passport framing, no head tilt, horizontal eyes, natural symmetrical shoulders; right = true90-degree RIGHT-facing profile (nose to outer right). All same head size/crop hair top to upper chest, same85mm lens, same facial geometry across rotations. Identity reference face is authority, not a redesign. Neutral expression in ALL panels, relaxed mouth CLOSED without smile, no frown, calm awake eyes looking in direction head faces, no glancing down. grey fine vertical stripe shirt. Remove hat and glasses in all head portraits so features clear. Grey matte plain real backdrop, soft cool blue-grey natural daylight, balanced fill, realistic pores/texture/fine hair, quiet subtle grain. No beauty retouch, plastic/CG/anime/oily skin, no dramatic shadow. No text/labels/watermark. Preserve age and identity.
